messages:
sophia: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's billing incident — delayed token ingest + a few incorrect invoice lines. I sketched owners and a short timeline below, pls confirm or reassign by EOD PST. :white_check_mark:

aj: Thanks — can you paste the list of affected customers?

sophia: Filter used: `select account_id, min(ts), max(ts), total_tokens from meter_events where ts between '2026-03-18' and '2026-03-19' and ingest_status='delayed'` — exported as metering_delay_03-19.csv. Top 20 by token delta attached to the thread.

leo: I'll take the backfill script and run a dry-run on staging. Plan: patch transformer that replays missing events -> update ledger. ETA: 48h. Will post logs. :hammer_and_wrench:

maria: I can own invoice adjustments & customer comms. Will prepare a template credit notification and a spreadsheet of invoices to reissue. ETA: tomorrow noon PT.

sophia: Action list (short):
- Backfill replay (owner: leo) — run dry-run + verify token tallies against raw events.
- Ledger patch (owner: leo, reviewer: ops-review) — small schema-safe patch to apply deltas.
- Invoice reruns & credits (owner: maria) — generate corrected invoices and credits; coordinate billing cutover window.
- Postmortem doc updates (owner: aj) — add recurrence detection hypothesis and signal thresholds.
- Monitoring alerts (owner: ops-review) — new rule for ingest lag > 5m or token delta > 10% per hour.

aj: For verification, let's use this quick check after backfill: `select count(*) from invoices where invoice_date='2026-03-19' and adjusted=true` and compare to expected_adjusted_count in spreadsheet. Keep me looped.

leo: Dry-run log snippet:```
[2026-03-21T09:12:03Z] replayed 12,438 events for account 924
[2026-03-21T09:12:05Z] delta applied: +12420 tokens
[2026-03-21T09:12:05Z] reconcile check: pass
```

maria: Comm template draft: "We're reaching out about an invoicing correction for usage on 3/19. You'll see a credit of $X on your next invoice. Contact billing@redwood.ai if questions." Will share doc.

ops-review: New alert rule created in PagerDuty + Datadog: `meterting.ingest.lag > 300s` and `billing.token_delta_pct > 10` — test scheduled.

sophia: Risk notes: if backfill is partial we should prefer issuing temporary credits vs reissuing all invoices. Need approval from finance leadership for any customer-facing credits > $5k.

aj: Confirmed. tagging finance-leads in follow-up. Also let's capture a clear rollback plan for ledger patch (db snapshot + idempotent patch).

leo: Will push dry-run results to the shared folder and drop a short checklist when ready.

maria: I'll prepare customer list + templates and queue a sync with CS for messaging.

sophia: Thanks team. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when they accept ownership? I'll compile final action tracker and send calendar reminders.

billing-bot: Incident BLG-2026-03-19 updated: owners assigned (leo, maria, aj, ops-review), next update due 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC.

aj: :thumbsup:
